//===== Ragnarok Offline: adventurers-chronicle =============================
//= GENERATED by tools/build.ps1 from tools/chronicle.template.txt and
//= tools/story.ps1. Edit those and run build.ps1; don't edit this file.
//=
//= The Adventurer's Chronicle: an 8-chapter story that walks you across
//= Rune-Midgard by level. Progress is CHRON_STEP (1..40, 41 = finished;
//= step g of chapter c is (c-1)*5+s). Each step has a quest-window entry,
//= quest id 77000+g; hunt steps count kills there (companions' kills count
//= too: rAthena credits party members in range). Travel is in
//= npc/when/waykeepers (setting "waykeepers"): places found live in
//= NPCP_WM$/WX/WY, shared with npc-plus's Warper (the Waykeepers stand down
//= when it's on). Old CHRON_WM$/WX/WY are copied over once per character.
//= Data lives in $@chr_* server arrays so every NPC and function can read
//= it. The journal window (client/index.js) asks "@chronicle <n> state".
//===========================================================================

-	script	ChronicleCore	-1,{
	end;

OnInit:
	.mod$ = "adventurers-chronicle";
	$@chr_exprate = callfunc("F_ModSetting", .mod$, "exp_rate", 100);
	$@chr_share = callfunc("F_ModSetting", .mod$, "share_exp", 1);
	$@chr_test = callfunc("F_ModSetting", .mod$, "test_tools", 0);

	//@@DATA@@

	bindatcmd "chronicle", strnpcinfo(3) + "::OnCmd", 0, 99;

	initnpctimer;	// the tick below
	end;

// The tick: one NPC timer for everyone, every 2000 ms. `addrid 0, 1` runs the
// tick for each player but skips anyone busy in another script (an NPC
// dialog). Before, each player had a timer of their own, and during a long
// dialog those queued up until the queue was full and were dropped ("event
// queue is full"), which stopped them for good.
OnTimer2000:
	initnpctimer;
	addrid 0, 1;
	if (getcharid(3) >= 95000000)
		end;	// an AI player, not a person
	goto OnTick;

OnPCLoginEvent:
	if (!CHRON_STEP) {
		CHRON_STEP = 1;
		dispbottom "[Chronicle] Rumours travel fast in Prontera: monsters are stirring all over Rune-Midgard, and the knights are hiring adventurers.", 0xAADDFF;
		dispbottom "[Chronicle] Your Adventurer's Chronicle has begun. Open it with Alt+B or the book in your bag. First: " + $@chr_now$[1], 0xFFDD66;
		setquest 77001;
	}
	if (!countitem(50100) && CHRON_STEP <= 41)
		getitem 50100, 1;
	@chr_lastmap$ = "";
	// 1.3.1: before, a Side Quest's pouch came the moment it opened.
	if (!CHRON_V131) {
		for (.@i = 1; .@i <= $@sq_n; .@i++)
			if (CHRON_SQ[.@i] && $@sq_kit$[.@i] != "")
				CHRON_SQKIT = CHRON_SQKIT | (1 << .@i);
		CHRON_V131 = 1;
	}
	callfunc "F_ChronSideUnlock";
	end;

OnTick:
	getmapxy(.@map$, .@x, .@y);
	if (.@map$ != @chr_lastmap$) {
		@chr_lastmap$ = .@map$;
		@chr_mapat = gettimetick(2);
		callfunc "F_ChronBossMark";
		callfunc "F_ChronSideMark";
		callfunc "F_ChronArrive", .@map$;
		callfunc "F_ChronSideArrive", .@map$;
	}
	// Side Quests run beside the main road (and after it is finished).
	callfunc "F_ChronSideTick", .@map$;
	.@g = CHRON_STEP;
	if (.@g < 1 || .@g > $@chr_steps)
		end;
	if ($@chr_type[.@g] == 2) {
		if (checkquest(77000 + .@g, HUNTING) == 2)
			callfunc "F_ChronAdvance", .@g;
	}
	if ($@chr_type[.@g] == 3 || ($@chr_type[.@g] == 4 && $@chr_items$[.@g] != "")) {
		// Deliver (or a boss with items to bring along, like the Juperos
		// Crest Pieces): the side quest tracker shows the items in your bag
		// (client/index.js). Sent only when a count changes.
		.@have$ = .@g + " " + callfunc("F_ChronHave", .@g);
		if (.@have$ != @chr_have$) {
			@chr_have$ = .@have$;
			dispbottom "@@event chronicle items " + .@have$;
		}
	}
	if ($@chr_watch$[.@g] != "" || @chr_watch$ != "") {
		// Monsters the Journal follows (the Juperos Gate Switches): which are
		// still standing, as "<map> 1,3", or "<map> 0" when none are. Sent only
		// when it changes; an empty line when you leave the map.
		.@sw$ = "";
		explode(.@w$, $@chr_watch$[.@g], "|");
		if ($@chr_watch$[.@g] != "" && .@map$ == .@w$[0]) {
			explode(.@nm$, .@w$[2], ",");
			setarray .@alive[0], 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0;
			if (mobcount(.@map$, .@w$[1]) > 0) {
				freeloop(1);
				.@n = getmapunits(BL_MOB, .@map$, .@u);
				for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@n; .@i++) {
					.@who$ = rid2name(.@u[.@i]);
					for (.@k = 0; .@k < getarraysize(.@nm$); .@k++)
						if (.@who$ == .@nm$[.@k])
							.@alive[.@k] = 1;
				}
				freeloop(0);
			}
			for (.@k = 0; .@k < getarraysize(.@nm$); .@k++)
				if (.@alive[.@k])
					.@sw$ += (.@sw$ == "" ? "" : ",") + (.@k + 1);
			.@sw$ = .@map$ + " " + (.@sw$ == "" ? "0" : .@sw$);
		}
		if (.@sw$ != @chr_watch$) {
			@chr_watch$ = .@sw$;
			dispbottom "@@event chronicle watch " + .@sw$;
		}
	}
	if ($@chr_type[.@g] == 4 && .@map$ == $@chr_map$[.@g] && gettimetick(2) >= @chr_mapat + 3) {
		// One boss per arrival, rising where you stand a few seconds after you
		// arrive. A boss left from an earlier visit (still wandering the map, or
		// its unit id reused by another monster) is cleared first, without
		// counting as a kill: before 1.1.1 it blocked a new one for good.
		.@ev$ = strnpcinfo(3) + "::OnBossDead";
		if (@chr_bossat == @chr_mapat && mobcount(.@map$, .@ev$) < 1) {
			// It died while you were here but the kill never reached you (a
			// companion's last hit): it's slain all the same.
			@chr_boss = 0;
			@chr_bossat = 0;
			callfunc "F_ChronAdvance", .@g;
			end;
		}
		if (@chr_bossat != @chr_mapat) {
			killmonster .@map$, .@ev$;
			@chr_bossat = @chr_mapat;
			// Size_Large: the client draws it half again as big (only a look;
			// rAthena's mob_size_influence is off, so stats and drops stay).
			monster .@map$, .@x, .@y, $@chr_bname$[.@g], $@chr_bmob[.@g], 1, .@ev$, Size_Large;
			@chr_boss = $@mobid[0];
			getunitdata @chr_boss, .@d;
			setunitdata @chr_boss, UMOB_MAXHP, .@d[UMOB_MAXHP] * $@chr_bhp[.@g];
			setunitdata @chr_boss, UMOB_HP, .@d[UMOB_MAXHP] * $@chr_bhp[.@g];
			setunitdata @chr_boss, UMOB_ATKMIN, .@d[UMOB_ATKMIN] * 13 / 10;
			setunitdata @chr_boss, UMOB_ATKMAX, .@d[UMOB_ATKMAX] * 13 / 10;
			dispbottom "[Chronicle] The air turns cold. " + $@chr_bname$[.@g] + " appears! Look for the giant one, marked red on your minimap.", 0xFF7766;
		}
		// A red mark on the minimap follows the boss while it lives.
		if (@chr_boss && unitexists(@chr_boss)) {
			getunitdata @chr_boss, .@b;
			if (.@b[UMOB_CLASS] == $@chr_bmob[.@g] && (.@b[UMOB_X] != @chr_bmx || .@b[UMOB_Y] != @chr_bmy)) {
				@chr_bmx = .@b[UMOB_X];
				@chr_bmy = .@b[UMOB_Y];
				viewpoint 1, @chr_bmx, @chr_bmy, 77, 0xFF3333;
			}
		}
	}
	end;

OnBossDead:
	if (!playerattached())
		end;
	.@g = CHRON_STEP;
	@chr_boss = 0;
	if (.@g >= 1 && .@g <= $@chr_steps && $@chr_type[.@g] == 4 && killedrid == $@chr_bmob[.@g])
		callfunc "F_ChronAdvance", .@g;
	end;

OnSideBossDead:
	if (!playerattached())
		end;
	@chr_sb = 0;
	for (.@i = 1; .@i <= $@sq_n; .@i++) {
		.@k = CHRON_SQ[.@i];
		if (.@k < 1 || .@k > $@sq_steps[.@i])
			continue;
		.@s = .@i * 10 + .@k;
		if ($@sqs_type[.@s] == 4 && killedrid == $@sqs_bmob[.@s] && @chr_sbs == .@s) {
			if ($@sqs_loot$[.@s] != "") {
				// a boss that carries what the next step needs (a gate key)
				explode(.@p$, $@sqs_loot$[.@s], ",");
				getitem atoi(.@p$[0]), atoi(.@p$[1]);
				dispbottom "[Chronicle] " + $@sqs_bname$[.@s] + " dropped " + getitemname(atoi(.@p$[0])) + ".", 0xE5A15E;
			}
			callfunc "F_ChronSideAdvance", .@i;
			break;
		}
	}
	end;

// The MVP Ledger ticks itself: a kill counts for you and for the people of
// your party on the same map, so a companion's kill counts for its owner.
OnNPCKillEvent:
	for (.@m = 0; .@m < $@mvp_n; .@m++)
		if ($@mvp_id[.@m] == killedrid)
			break;
	if (.@m >= $@mvp_n)
		end;
	.@bit = 1 << .@m;
	.@map$ = strcharinfo(3);
	.@pid = getcharid(1);
	if (.@pid) {
		getpartymember .@pid, 2;
		.@n = $@partymembercount;
		copyarray .@aid[0], $@partymemberaid[0], .@n;
	} else {
		.@n = 1;
		.@aid[0] = getcharid(3);
	}
	for (.@j = 0; .@j < .@n; .@j++) {
		if (.@aid[.@j] >= 95000000)
			continue;	// an AI player
		if (!attachrid(.@aid[.@j]))
			continue;
		if (strcharinfo(3) == .@map$ && !(CHRON_MVPK & .@bit)) {
			CHRON_MVPK = CHRON_MVPK | .@bit;
			dispbottom "[Chronicle] MVP Ledger: " + $@mvp_name$[.@m] + " defeated!", 0xFF7766;
			dispbottom "@@event chronicle refresh";
		}
	}
	end;

// @chronicle opens the journal; the window asks "@chronicle <n> state".
// With the "Test tools" setting on, "@chronicle side <quest> <step>" puts you
// on any Side Quest step (0: not open, 100: done).
OnCmd:
	if (.@atcmd_numparameters >= 3 && .@atcmd_parameters$[0] == "side") {
		if (!$@chr_test) {
			dispbottom "[Chronicle] Turn on the Test tools setting of adventurers-chronicle first.";
			end;
		}
		.@i = atoi(.@atcmd_parameters$[1]);
		.@k = atoi(.@atcmd_parameters$[2]);
		if (.@i < 1 || .@i > $@sq_n || (.@k > $@sq_steps[.@i] && .@k != 100) || .@k < 0) {
			dispbottom "[Chronicle] Usage: @chronicle side <1-" + $@sq_n + "> <step, 0 or 100>";
			end;
		}
		for (.@j = 1; .@j <= $@sq_steps[.@i]; .@j++)
			if (checkquest(77100 + .@i * 10 + .@j) >= 0)
				erasequest 77100 + .@i * 10 + .@j;
		CHRON_SQ[.@i] = .@k;
		if (.@k >= 1 && .@k <= $@sq_steps[.@i])
			setquest 77100 + .@i * 10 + .@k;
		callfunc "F_ChronSideMark";
		@chr_lastmap$ = "";	// bosses and arrivals count again
		dispbottom "[Chronicle] " + $@sq_title$[.@i] + " is now at step " + .@k + ".";
		dispbottom "@@event chronicle refresh";
		end;
	}
	if (.@atcmd_numparameters >= 2 && .@atcmd_parameters$[1] == "state") {
		.@g = CHRON_STEP;
		.@hunt = -1;
		if (.@g >= 1 && .@g <= $@chr_steps && $@chr_type[.@g] == 2)
			.@hunt = checkquest(77000 + .@g, HUNTING);
		.@have$ = "";
		if (.@g >= 1 && .@g <= $@chr_steps && $@chr_items$[.@g] != "" && ($@chr_type[.@g] == 3 || $@chr_type[.@g] == 4))
			.@have$ = callfunc("F_ChronHave", .@g);
		// Side Quests, one "step:hunt:items:ro:fail" per quest, ';' between them.
		.@sq$ = "";
		for (.@i = 1; .@i <= $@sq_n; .@i++) {
			.@k = CHRON_SQ[.@i];
			.@h = -1;
			.@hv$ = "";
			.@ro = -1;
			if (.@k >= 1 && .@k <= $@sq_steps[.@i]) {
				.@s = .@i * 10 + .@k;
				if ($@sqs_type[.@s] == 2)
					.@h = checkquest(77100 + .@s, HUNTING);
				if ($@sqs_items$[.@s] != "")
					.@hv$ = callfunc("F_ChronHaveList", $@sqs_items$[.@s]);
				if ($@sqs_var$[.@s] != "")
					.@ro = getd($@sqs_var$[.@s]);
			}
			.@fail = 0;
			if (.@k >= 1 && .@k <= $@sq_steps[.@i])
				.@fail = callfunc("F_ChronSideFail", .@i);
			.@sq$ += (.@i > 1 ? ";" : "") + .@k + ":" + .@h + ":" + .@hv$ + ":" + .@ro + ":" + (.@fail ? 1 : 0);
		}
		dispbottom "@@reply " + .@atcmd_parameters$[0] + " 1/1 " + .@g + "|" + BaseLevel + "|" + getarraysize(NPCP_WM$) + "|" + CHRON_SKIP + "|" + .@hunt + "|" + .@have$ + "|" + @chr_watch$ + "|" + callfunc("F_ChronCapped") + "|" + .@sq$ + "|" + CHRON_MVPK;
		end;
	}
	dispbottom "@@event chronicle open";
	end;
}

// The chapter NPCs: one script, a duplicate per chapter ("Name#c<n>").
-	script	ChronNPC	-1,{
	callfunc "F_ChronTalk", atoi(delchar(strnpcinfo(2), 0));
	end;
}

// The Side Quest givers of their own ("Name#s<n>").
-	script	ChronSide	-1,{
	callfunc "F_ChronSideTalk", atoi(delchar(strnpcinfo(2), 0));
	end;
}

// Finish step getarg(0): quest window, EXP, and the next step.
function	script	F_ChronAdvance	{
	.@g = getarg(0);
	if (CHRON_STEP != .@g)
		return;
	if (checkquest(77000 + .@g) >= 0 && checkquest(77000 + .@g) < 2)
		completequest 77000 + .@g;
	CHRON_STEP = .@g + 1;
	callfunc "F_ChronBossMark";
	callfunc "F_ChronSideUnlock";
	dispbottom "[Chronicle] " + $@chr_title$[.@g] + ": complete!", 0xFFDD66;
	.@target = $@chr_final;
	if (.@g < $@chr_steps)
		.@target = $@chr_lv[.@g + 1];
	callfunc "F_ChronReward", .@target;
	if ($@chr_share)
		callfunc "F_ChronShare", .@target;
	specialeffect2 EF_ANGEL2;
	if (.@g < $@chr_steps) {
		setquest 77000 + .@g + 1;
		dispbottom "[Chronicle] Next: " + $@chr_now$[.@g + 1], 0xAADDFF;
	} else {
		dispbottom "[Chronicle] Your Chronicle is complete. You are a Champion of Rune-Midgard.", 0xFFDD66;
	}
	dispbottom "@@event chronicle refresh";
	return;
}

// Take the boss's red minimap mark away (it's slain, or you left its map).
function	script	F_ChronBossMark	{
	if (@chr_bmx || @chr_bmy)
		viewpoint 2, @chr_bmx, @chr_bmy, 77, 0xFF3333;
	@chr_bmx = 0;
	@chr_bmy = 0;
	return;
}

// How many of deliver step getarg(0)'s items are in the bag: "3,10" (one
// count per item, in the step's order).
function	script	F_ChronHave	{
	return callfunc("F_ChronHaveList", $@chr_items$[getarg(0)]);
}

// The same for an item list getarg(0): "id,count,name;id,count,name".
function	script	F_ChronHaveList	{
	explode(.@it$, getarg(0), ";");
	.@s$ = "";
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < getarraysize(.@it$); .@i++) {
		explode(.@p$, .@it$[.@i], ",");
		.@s$ += (.@i ? "," : "") + countitem(atoi(.@p$[0]));
	}
	return .@s$;
}

// 1 when you (or character id getarg(0)) stand at the server's level cap.
// rAthena's NextBaseExp there is MAX_LEVEL_BASE_EXP (99,999,999), not 0.
function	script	F_ChronCapped	{
	.@next = readparam(NextBaseExp, getarg(0, getcharid(0)));
	return (.@next <= 0 || .@next == 99999999);
}

// EXP toward level getarg(0): at 100% exactly there, scaled by "Quest EXP".
// Already there or past it: a quarter of a level. Plus some job EXP.
// For you, or for character id getarg(1) (a companion, F_ChronShare).
function	script	F_ChronReward	{
	.@t = getarg(0);
	.@c = getarg(1, getcharid(0));
	.@rate = $@chr_exprate;
	if (.@rate <= 0)
		return;
	.@from = readparam(BaseLevel, .@c);
	if (callfunc("F_ChronCapped", .@c)) {
		// at the cap base EXP has nowhere to go
	} else if (.@t > .@from) {
		.@span = (.@t - .@from) * .@rate;	// hundredths of a level
		.@goal = .@from + .@span / 100;
		.@frac = .@span % 100;
		for (.@i = 0; .@i < 400 && readparam(BaseLevel, .@c) < .@goal; .@i++) {
			if (callfunc("F_ChronCapped", .@c))
				break;
			.@next = readparam(NextBaseExp, .@c);
			.@need = .@next - readparam(BaseExp, .@c);
			if (.@need <= 0)
				break;
			callfunc "F_ChronGetExp", .@need, 0, .@c;
		}
		.@next = readparam(NextBaseExp, .@c);
		if (.@frac > 0 && !callfunc("F_ChronCapped", .@c)) {
			.@e = .@next * .@frac / 100;
			if (.@e > 0)
				callfunc "F_ChronGetExp", .@e, 0, .@c;
		}
	} else if (readparam(NextBaseExp, .@c) > 0) {
		.@e = readparam(NextBaseExp, .@c) * .@rate / 400;
		if (.@e > 0)
			callfunc "F_ChronGetExp", .@e, 0, .@c;
	}
	if (readparam(NextJobExp, .@c) > 0) {
		.@e = readparam(NextJobExp, .@c) * .@rate * 6 / 1000;
		if (.@e > 0)
			callfunc "F_ChronGetExp", 0, .@e, .@c;
	}
	return;
}

// getexp getarg(0) base and getarg(1) job EXP to character id getarg(2),
// exactly: rAthena multiplies script EXP by the server's quest_exp_rate
// (5000% on a 50x server), so the amount is divided by it first.
function	script	F_ChronGetExp	{
	.@rate = getbattleflag("quest_exp_rate");
	if (.@rate <= 0)
		.@rate = 100;
	.@b = getarg(0);
	.@j = getarg(1);
	if (.@rate != 100) {
		.@b = .@b / .@rate * 100 + (.@b % .@rate) * 100 / .@rate;
		.@j = .@j / .@rate * 100 + (.@j % .@rate) * 100 / .@rate;
		if (getarg(0) > 0 && .@b < 1)
			.@b = 1;
		if (getarg(1) > 0 && .@j < 1)
			.@j = 1;
	}
	getexp .@b, .@j, getarg(2);
	return;
}

// "Companions share quest EXP": every companion in your party gets the same
// reward, each pulled toward the same level as you, so one that trails
// catches up. Companions are the party members with char id 95000000 and up
// (population-engine shells); one that isn't summoned is skipped.
function	script	F_ChronShare	{
	.@pid = getcharid(1);
	if (!.@pid)
		return;
	getpartymember .@pid, 1;
	.@n = $@partymembercount;
	copyarray .@cid[0], $@partymembercid[0], .@n;
	.@got = 0;
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@n; .@i++) {
		if (.@cid[.@i] < 95000000)
			continue;
		if (readparam(Hp, .@cid[.@i]) < 0)
			continue;	// not summoned
		callfunc "F_ChronReward", getarg(0), .@cid[.@i];
		.@got++;
	}
	if (.@got)
		dispbottom "[Chronicle] Your companions share the quest EXP.", 0xAADDFF;
	return;
}

// NPC lines getarg(1) ("a|b|c"), one page each, under the name getarg(0).
function	script	F_ChronSay	{
	explode(.@l$, getarg(1), "|");
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < getarraysize(.@l$); .@i++) {
		if (.@i) {
			next;
		}
		mes getarg(0);
		mes .@l$[.@i];
	}
	return;
}

// Talking to the chapter NPC getarg(0).
function	script	F_ChronTalk	{
	.@ch = getarg(0);
	.@first = (.@ch - 1) * 5 + 1;
	.@last = .@first + 4;
	.@g = CHRON_STEP;
	if (.@g < 1)
		.@g = 1;
	.@n$ = "[" + $@chr_npc$[.@ch] + "]";

	// A Side Quest this NPC gave you, with news to tell.
	for (.@i = 1; .@i <= $@sq_n; .@i++) {
		if ($@sq_ch[.@i] != .@ch || $@sq_npc$[.@i] != "")
			continue;
		.@k = CHRON_SQ[.@i];
		if (.@k == 100) {
			if ((CHRON_SQSW & (1 << .@i)) || (!countitem($@sq_cost[.@i]) && !countitem($@sq_cost2[.@i])))
				continue;
		} else {
			if (.@k < 1 || .@k > $@sq_steps[.@i])
				continue;
			.@t = $@sqs_type[.@i * 10 + .@k];
			if (.@t != 1 && .@t != 5)
				continue;
		}
		if (select("Side Quest - " + $@sq_title$[.@i] + ":Talk about the Chronicle") == 1) {
			callfunc "F_ChronSideTalk", .@i;
			end;
		}
		break;
	}

	// The first NPC offers experienced adventurers a start at their level.
	if (.@ch == 1 && .@g == 1) {
		.@best = 1;
		for (.@c = 2; .@c <= $@chr_chapters; .@c++) {
			if (BaseLevel >= $@chr_lv[(.@c - 1) * 5 + 1])
				.@best = .@c;
		}
		if (.@best > 1) {
			mes .@n$;
			mes "You carry yourself like a veteran. I could start you from the beginning, or tell you in brief what has happened and send you where the trouble is now.";
			next;
			if (select("Start from the beginning:Skip ahead to Chapter " + .@best + ", " + $@chr_ctitle$[.@best]) == 2) {
				if (checkquest(77001) >= 0)
					erasequest 77001;
				CHRON_SKIP = .@best - 1;
				CHRON_STEP = (.@best - 1) * 5 + 1;
				setquest 77000 + CHRON_STEP;
				mes .@n$;
				mes "Then here it is in brief. Monsters are waking all over Rune-Midgard, where they have slept for centuries. Something is pulling at the old seals.";
				mes "Your Chronicle holds the story so far. Go to " + $@chr_townname$[.@best] + " and find " + $@chr_npc$[.@best] + ".";
				close2;
				callfunc "F_ChronSideUnlock";
				dispbottom "@@event chronicle refresh";
				end;
			}
		}
	}
	if (.@g < .@first) {
		mes .@n$;
		mes "I am waiting for someone. Not you, I think. Not yet.";
		close;
	}
	if (.@g > .@last) {
		mes .@n$;
		mes "You have done more for us than I can repay. Your road goes on without me now. Check your Chronicle (Alt+B) for where it leads.";
		close;
	}
	// At the server's level cap nothing is out of reach: chapter 8 asks
	// for 99-110, which a server capped at 99 never reaches.
	if (BaseLevel < $@chr_lv[.@g] && !callfunc("F_ChronCapped")) {
		mes .@n$;
		mes "You are not ready for this yet. Come back when you reach level " + $@chr_lv[.@g] + ".";
		close;
	}
	.@t = $@chr_type[.@g];
	if (.@t == 1) {
		callfunc "F_ChronSay", .@n$, $@chr_say$[.@g];
		close2;
		if (!countitem(50100))
			getitem 50100, 1;
		callfunc "F_ChronAdvance", .@g;
		end;
	}
	if (.@t == 3) {
		explode(.@it$, $@chr_items$[.@g], ";");
		.@ok = 1;
		for (.@i = 0; .@i < getarraysize(.@it$); .@i++) {
			explode(.@p$, .@it$[.@i], ",");
			if (countitem(atoi(.@p$[0])) < atoi(.@p$[1]))
				.@ok = 0;
		}
		if (!.@ok) {
			mes .@n$;
			mes $@chr_now$[.@g];
			for (.@i = 0; .@i < getarraysize(.@it$); .@i++) {
				explode(.@p$, .@it$[.@i], ",");
				mes "- " + getitemname(atoi(.@p$[0])) + ": " + countitem(atoi(.@p$[0])) + " / " + .@p$[1];
			}
			close;
		}
		for (.@i = 0; .@i < getarraysize(.@it$); .@i++) {
			explode(.@p$, .@it$[.@i], ",");
			delitem atoi(.@p$[0]), atoi(.@p$[1]);
		}
		callfunc "F_ChronSay", .@n$, $@chr_say$[.@g];
		close2;
		callfunc "F_ChronAdvance", .@g;
		end;
	}
	if (.@t == 5) {
		callfunc "F_ChronSay", .@n$, $@chr_say$[.@g];
		next;
		mes .@n$;
		mes "Before you go, take something to remember this by. Choose one.";
		.@c1 = $@chr_cost[.@ch * 3 - 2];
		.@c2 = $@chr_cost[.@ch * 3 - 1];
		.@c3 = $@chr_cost[.@ch * 3];
		.@pick = select(getitemname(.@c1) + ":" + getitemname(.@c2) + ":" + getitemname(.@c3));
		.@c = .@c1;
		if (.@pick == 2)
			.@c = .@c2;
		else if (.@pick == 3)
			.@c = .@c3;
		getitem .@c, 1;
		explode(.@it$, $@chr_gift$[.@ch], ";");
		for (.@i = 0; .@i < getarraysize(.@it$); .@i++) {
			explode(.@p$, .@it$[.@i], ",");
			getitem atoi(.@p$[0]), atoi(.@p$[1]);
		}
		Zeny += $@chr_zeny[.@ch];
		close2;
		dispbottom "[Chronicle] Chapter " + .@ch + " complete: " + $@chr_ctitle$[.@ch] + ". You received " + getitemname(.@c) + " and " + $@chr_zeny[.@ch] + " zeny.", 0xFFDD66;
		callfunc "F_ChronAdvance", .@g;
		end;
	}
	// Hunting or a boss: a reminder (with what to bring along, if anything).
	mes .@n$;
	mes $@chr_now$[.@g];
	if (.@t == 4 && $@chr_items$[.@g] != "") {
		explode(.@it$, $@chr_items$[.@g], ";");
		for (.@i = 0; .@i < getarraysize(.@it$); .@i++) {
			explode(.@p$, .@it$[.@i], ",");
			mes "- " + .@p$[2] + ": " + countitem(atoi(.@p$[0])) + " / " + .@p$[1];
		}
		mes "Your Chronicle (Alt+B) tells the way down.";
	}
	close;
}

// Arriving on a map the Chronicle cares about: a hint, or a mark on the minimap.
function	script	F_ChronArrive	{
	.@m$ = getarg(0);
	.@g = CHRON_STEP;
	if (.@g < 1 || .@g > $@chr_steps)
		return;
	.@ch = (.@g - 1) / 5 + 1;
	.@t = $@chr_type[.@g];
	if ((.@t == 1 || .@t == 3 || .@t == 5) && .@m$ == $@chr_town$[.@ch]) {
		viewpoint 1, $@chr_x[.@ch], $@chr_y[.@ch], 1, 0xFFDD00;
		dispbottom "[Chronicle] " + $@chr_npc$[.@ch] + " is marked on your minimap.", 0xAADDFF;
	} else if (.@t == 2 && .@m$ == $@chr_map$[.@g]) {
		dispbottom "[Chronicle] This is the hunting ground: " + $@chr_now$[.@g], 0xAADDFF;
	} else if (.@t == 4 && .@m$ == $@chr_map$[.@g]) {
		dispbottom "[Chronicle] Something here has been waiting for you...", 0xFF9977;
	}
	return;
}

// ---- Side Quests ----------------------------------------------------------
// Optional quests the chapter NPCs mention on the way. CHRON_SQ[n] is 0 until
// the main road passes the hook step, then the step you are on (1..), then
// 100 once done. Step k of Side Quest n has the id n*10+k ($@sqs_* arrays,
// quest 77100+id). Types: 1 talk, 2 hunt, 4 boss, 5 report, 6 reach (set foot
// on a map), 7 ro (RO's own quest: done when its variable reaches a value).

// Open the Side Quests whose hook the main road has passed.
function	script	F_ChronSideUnlock	{
	for (.@i = 1; .@i <= $@sq_n; .@i++) {
		if (CHRON_SQ[.@i] || CHRON_STEP <= $@sq_hook[.@i])
			continue;
		CHRON_SQ[.@i] = 1;
		if (checkquest(77100 + .@i * 10 + 1) < 0)
			setquest 77100 + .@i * 10 + 1;
		dispbottom "[Chronicle] New Side Quest (optional): " + $@sq_title$[.@i] + ". It waits in your Journal (Alt+B), Side Quests tab.", 0xE5A15E;
		if ($@sq_kit$[.@i] != "" && !$@sq_kitk[.@i]) {
			explode(.@it$, $@sq_kit$[.@i], ";");
			for (.@j = 0; .@j < getarraysize(.@it$); .@j++) {
				explode(.@p$, .@it$[.@j], ",");
				getitem atoi(.@p$[0]), atoi(.@p$[1]);
			}
			CHRON_SQKIT = CHRON_SQKIT | (1 << .@i);
			dispbottom "[Chronicle] " + $@chr_npc$[$@sq_ch[.@i]] + " gave you a pouch for the road ahead.", 0xE5A15E;
		}
		.@new++;
	}
	if (.@new)
		dispbottom "@@event chronicle refresh";
	return;
}

// Side Quest getarg(0) moves to its next step (or is done).
function	script	F_ChronSideAdvance	{
	.@i = getarg(0);
	.@k = CHRON_SQ[.@i];
	if (.@k < 1 || .@k > $@sq_steps[.@i])
		return;
	.@s = .@i * 10 + .@k;
	if (checkquest(77100 + .@s) >= 0 && checkquest(77100 + .@s) < 2)
		completequest 77100 + .@s;
	callfunc "F_ChronSideMark";
	if (.@k >= $@sq_steps[.@i]) {
		callfunc "F_ChronSideDone", .@i;
		return;
	}
	CHRON_SQ[.@i] = .@k + 1;
	if (checkquest(77100 + .@s + 1) < 0)
		setquest 77100 + .@s + 1;
	dispbottom "[Chronicle] " + $@sq_title$[.@i] + ": " + $@sqs_title$[.@s] + " done. Next: " + $@sqs_now$[.@s + 1], 0xE5A15E;
	dispbottom "@@event chronicle refresh";
	return;
}

// Side Quest getarg(0) is done: its costume, a small reward, a Passport stamp.
function	script	F_ChronSideDone	{
	.@i = getarg(0);
	CHRON_SQ[.@i] = 100;
	.@cost = (@chr_pick == 2 ? $@sq_cost2[.@i] : $@sq_cost[.@i]);
	@chr_pick = 0;
	getitem .@cost, 1;
	explode(.@it$, $@sq_gift$[.@i], ";");
	for (.@j = 0; .@j < getarraysize(.@it$); .@j++) {
		explode(.@p$, .@it$[.@j], ",");
		getitem atoi(.@p$[0]), atoi(.@p$[1]);
	}
	Zeny += $@sq_zeny[.@i];
	callfunc "F_ChronReward", 0;	// a quarter of a level, and some job EXP
	if ($@chr_share)
		callfunc "F_ChronShare", 0;
	specialeffect2 EF_ANGEL2;
	dispbottom "[Chronicle] Side Quest complete: " + $@sq_title$[.@i] + ". You received " + getitemname(.@cost) + ", " + $@sq_zeny[.@i] + " zeny and a Passport stamp.", 0xFFDD66;
	for (.@j = 1; .@j <= $@sq_n; .@j++)
		if (CHRON_SQ[.@j] == 100)
			.@stamps++;
	for (.@r = 1; .@r <= $@pp_n; .@r++) {
		if (.@stamps < $@pp_need[.@r] || (CHRON_PASS & (1 << .@r)))
			continue;
		CHRON_PASS = CHRON_PASS | (1 << .@r);
		getitem $@pp_item[.@r], 1;
		dispbottom "[Chronicle] Passport rank " + $@pp_name$[.@r] + "! You received " + getitemname($@pp_item[.@r]) + ".", 0xFFDD66;
	}
	dispbottom "@@event chronicle refresh";
	return;
}

// Talking to the giver of Side Quest getarg(0).
function	script	F_ChronSideTalk	{
	.@i = getarg(0);
	.@n$ = "[" + $@sq_npc$[.@i] + "]";
	if ($@sq_npc$[.@i] == "")
		.@n$ = "[" + $@chr_npc$[$@sq_ch[.@i]] + "]";
	.@k = CHRON_SQ[.@i];
	if (.@k == 100) {
		mes .@n$;
		mes ($@sq_after$[.@i] != "" ? $@sq_after$[.@i] : "Thank you again, friend.");
		// Once, you can trade the keepsake you chose for the other one.
		if (CHRON_SQSW & (1 << .@i))
			close;
		.@a = $@sq_cost[.@i];
		.@b = $@sq_cost2[.@i];
		if (!countitem(.@a) && !countitem(.@b))
			close;
		next;
		.@have = (countitem(.@a) ? .@a : .@b);
		.@other = (.@have == .@a ? .@b : .@a);
		mes .@n$;
		mes "Not sure about your " + getitemname(.@have) + "? I can trade it for the " + getitemname(.@other) + ", once.";
		if (select("Trade it:Keep it") == 2)
			close;
		delitem .@have, 1;
		getitem .@other, 1;
		CHRON_SQSW = CHRON_SQSW | (1 << .@i);
		mes "There you are.";
		close;
	}
	if (.@k < 1) {
		mes .@n$;
		mes ($@sq_idle$[.@i] != "" ? $@sq_idle$[.@i] : "Not now, friend.");
		close;
	}
	.@s = .@i * 10 + .@k;
	.@t = $@sqs_type[.@s];
	if (.@t == 1) {
		callfunc "F_ChronSay", .@n$, $@sqs_say$[.@s];
		close2;
		if ($@sq_kitk[.@i] == .@k && !(CHRON_SQKIT & (1 << .@i))) {
			CHRON_SQKIT = CHRON_SQKIT | (1 << .@i);
			explode(.@it$, $@sq_kit$[.@i], ";");
			for (.@j = 0; .@j < getarraysize(.@it$); .@j++) {
				explode(.@p$, .@it$[.@j], ",");
				getitem atoi(.@p$[0]), atoi(.@p$[1]);
				.@got$ += (.@j ? ", " : "") + .@p$[1] + " " + getitemname(atoi(.@p$[0]));
			}
			dispbottom "[Chronicle] " + $@sq_npc$[.@i] + " handed you a pouch: " + .@got$ + ". Keep these, the quest asks for them. Don't sell them!", 0xE5A15E;
		}
		callfunc "F_ChronSideAdvance", .@i;
		end;
	}
	if (.@t == 5) {
		// The last line offers the two keepsakes; the choice comes right under it.
		callfunc "F_ChronSay", .@n$, $@sqs_say$[.@s];
		@chr_pick = select(getitemname($@sq_cost[.@i]) + ":" + getitemname($@sq_cost2[.@i]));
		close2;
		callfunc "F_ChronSideAdvance", .@i;
		end;
	}
	// Too strong for RO's own part of this step (Orc's Memory admits Lv 30-80):
	// the giver tells it instead, and the step counts as done.
	if ($@sqs_maxlv[.@s] && BaseLevel > $@sqs_maxlv[.@s]) {
		mes .@n$;
		mes $@sqs_altask$[.@s];
		next;
		if (select("Read the notes:Not now") == 2) {
			mes .@n$;
			mes "Come back whenever you like.";
			close;
		}
		callfunc "F_ChronSay", .@n$, $@sqs_alt$[.@s];
		close2;
		callfunc "F_ChronSideAdvance", .@i;
		end;
	}
	// Lost or sold the pouch? The giver replaces what is left of it for the
	// current step: the kit minus what earlier steps used up. Once per step
	// (CHRON_SQKRS[n] = the step it was last replaced at). A step the pouch
	// never covered gets the giver's "find it yourself" lines ($@sq_nokit$).
	if ($@sq_kitk[.@i] && .@k > $@sq_kitk[.@i] && (CHRON_SQKIT & (1 << .@i)) && $@sqs_items$[.@s] != "") {
		explode(.@kit$, $@sq_kit$[.@i], ";");
		.@cnt = 0;
		.@covers = 0;
		for (.@j = 0; .@j < getarraysize(.@kit$); .@j++) {
			explode(.@p$, .@kit$[.@j], ",");
			.@id = atoi(.@p$[0]);
			.@left = atoi(.@p$[1]);
			for (.@e = $@sq_kitk[.@i] + 1; .@e < .@k; .@e++)
				.@left -= callfunc("F_ChronItemNeed", $@sqs_items$[.@i * 10 + .@e], .@id);
			.@want = callfunc("F_ChronItemNeed", $@sqs_items$[.@s], .@id);
			if (.@want > .@left)
				.@want = .@left;
			if (.@want > 0)
				.@covers = 1;
			.@give = .@want - countitem(.@id);
			if (.@give > 0) {
				.@gid[.@cnt] = .@id;
				.@gamt[.@cnt] = .@give;
				.@cnt++;
			}
		}
		if (.@cnt && CHRON_SQKRS[.@i] != .@k) {
			mes .@n$;
			mes "Wait, where is Nafisa's pouch? Lost it? Sold it?!";
			mes "...Lucky for you, she packed spares. She always does.";
			next;
			for (.@j = 0; .@j < .@cnt; .@j++) {
				getitem .@gid[.@j], .@gamt[.@j];
				.@got$ += (.@j ? ", " : "") + .@gamt[.@j] + " " + getitemname(.@gid[.@j]);
			}
			CHRON_SQKRS[.@i] = .@k;
			mes .@n$;
			mes "Here: " + .@got$ + ".";
			mes "Keep these this time, and don't sell them!";
			dispbottom "[Chronicle] " + $@sq_npc$[.@i] + " replaced the pouch: " + .@got$ + ".", 0xE5A15E;
			close;
		}
		if (!.@covers && $@sq_nokit$[.@i] != "") {
			callfunc "F_ChronSay", .@n$, $@sq_nokit$[.@i];
			close;
		}
	}
	mes .@n$;
	mes $@sqs_now$[.@s];
	close;
}

// Every tick: hunts counted, maps reached, RO quests moved on, bosses risen.
function	script	F_ChronSideTick	{
	.@map$ = getarg(0);
	for (.@i = 1; .@i <= $@sq_n; .@i++) {
		.@k = CHRON_SQ[.@i];
		if (.@k < 1 || .@k > $@sq_steps[.@i])
			continue;
		.@s = .@i * 10 + .@k;
		.@t = $@sqs_type[.@s];
		if (.@t == 2) {
			if (checkquest(77100 + .@s, HUNTING) == 2)
				callfunc "F_ChronSideAdvance", .@i;
		} else if (.@t == 6) {
			if (.@map$ == $@sqs_map$[.@s])
				callfunc "F_ChronSideAdvance", .@i;
		} else if (.@t == 7) {
			// RO's own quest moved on inside this step (a slate read, a talk
			// done): say which part, and refresh the Journal. The first look
			// after login or a new step only notes the value.
			.@v = getd($@sqs_var$[.@s]);
			if (@chr_sqs[.@i] != .@s) {
				@chr_sqs[.@i] = .@s;
				@chr_sqv[.@i] = .@v;
			} else if (@chr_sqv[.@i] != .@v) {
				@chr_sqv[.@i] = .@v;
				if (!callfunc("F_ChronRoCond", .@s))
					callfunc "F_ChronSidePart", .@s, .@v;
				dispbottom "@@event chronicle refresh";
			}
			// RO's own quest: steps done before (or several at once) move on now.
			for (.@n = 0; .@n < 10; .@n++) {
				.@k = CHRON_SQ[.@i];
				if (.@k < 1 || .@k > $@sq_steps[.@i])
					break;
				.@s = .@i * 10 + .@k;
				if ($@sqs_type[.@s] != 7 || !callfunc("F_ChronRoCond", .@s))
					break;
				callfunc "F_ChronSideAdvance", .@i;
			}
		} else if (.@t == 4) {
			callfunc "F_ChronSideBoss", .@s, .@map$;
		}
	}
	return;
}

// How many of item getarg(1) an item list ("id,count,name;...") asks for.
function	script	F_ChronItemNeed	{
	explode(.@l$, getarg(0), ";");
	for (.@j = 0; .@j < getarraysize(.@l$); .@j++) {
		explode(.@q$, .@l$[.@j], ",");
		if (atoi(.@q$[0]) == getarg(1))
			return atoi(.@q$[1]);
	}
	return 0;
}

// Side Quest step getarg(0): RO's quest variable is now getarg(1). Name the
// part just done and the next one ($@sqs_parts$ "at|name;...").
function	script	F_ChronSidePart	{
	.@s = getarg(0);
	.@v = getarg(1);
	if ($@sqs_parts$[.@s] == "")
		return;
	explode(.@pt$, $@sqs_parts$[.@s], ";");
	.@done$ = "";
	.@next$ = "";
	for (.@j = 0; .@j < getarraysize(.@pt$); .@j++) {
		explode(.@p$, .@pt$[.@j], "|");
		.@at = atoi(.@p$[0]);
		if (.@at == .@v)
			.@done$ = .@p$[1];
		else if (.@at > .@v && .@next$ == "")
			.@next$ = .@p$[1];
	}
	if (.@done$ == "")
		return;
	dispbottom "[Chronicle] " + $@sq_title$[.@s / 10] + ": done, " + .@done$ + "." + (.@next$ != "" ? " Next: " + .@next$ + "." : ""), 0xE5A15E;
	return;
}

// A Side Quest boss (step getarg(0)) rising where you stand on its map: one
// per arrival, like the chapter bosses (see OnTick).
function	script	F_ChronSideBoss	{
	.@s = getarg(0);
	.@map$ = getarg(1);
	if (.@map$ != $@sqs_map$[.@s] || gettimetick(2) < @chr_mapat + 3)
		return;
	.@ev$ = "ChronicleCore::OnSideBossDead";
	if (@chr_sbat == @chr_mapat && @chr_sbs == .@s && mobcount(.@map$, .@ev$) < 1) {
		// slain while you were here, but the kill never reached you
		@chr_sbat = 0;
		@chr_sb = 0;
		callfunc "F_ChronSideAdvance", .@s / 10;
		return;
	}
	if (@chr_sbat != @chr_mapat || @chr_sbs != .@s) {
		killmonster .@map$, .@ev$;
		@chr_sbat = @chr_mapat;
		@chr_sbs = .@s;
		getmapxy(.@m$, .@x, .@y);
		monster .@map$, .@x, .@y, $@sqs_bname$[.@s], $@sqs_bmob[.@s], 1, .@ev$, Size_Large;
		@chr_sb = $@mobid[0];
		getunitdata @chr_sb, .@d;
		setunitdata @chr_sb, UMOB_MAXHP, .@d[UMOB_MAXHP] * $@sqs_bhp[.@s];
		setunitdata @chr_sb, UMOB_HP, .@d[UMOB_MAXHP] * $@sqs_bhp[.@s];
		setunitdata @chr_sb, UMOB_ATKMIN, .@d[UMOB_ATKMIN] * 13 / 10;
		setunitdata @chr_sb, UMOB_ATKMAX, .@d[UMOB_ATKMAX] * 13 / 10;
		dispbottom "[Chronicle] " + $@sqs_bname$[.@s] + " appears! Look for the giant one, marked red on your minimap.", 0xFF7766;
	}
	if (@chr_sb && unitexists(@chr_sb)) {
		getunitdata @chr_sb, .@b;
		if (.@b[UMOB_CLASS] == $@sqs_bmob[.@s] && (.@b[UMOB_X] != @chr_sbmx || .@b[UMOB_Y] != @chr_sbmy)) {
			@chr_sbmx = .@b[UMOB_X];
			@chr_sbmy = .@b[UMOB_Y];
			viewpoint 1, @chr_sbmx, @chr_sbmy, 78, 0xFF3333;
		}
	}
	return;
}

// Take the Side Quest boss's red minimap mark away.
function	script	F_ChronSideMark	{
	if (@chr_sbmx || @chr_sbmy)
		viewpoint 2, @chr_sbmx, @chr_sbmy, 78, 0xFF3333;
	@chr_sbmx = 0;
	@chr_sbmy = 0;
	return;
}

// Arriving on a map one of your Side Quests cares about.
function	script	F_ChronSideArrive	{
	.@m$ = getarg(0);
	for (.@i = 1; .@i <= $@sq_n; .@i++) {
		.@k = CHRON_SQ[.@i];
		if (.@k < 1 || .@k > $@sq_steps[.@i])
			continue;
		.@s = .@i * 10 + .@k;
		if (.@m$ != $@sqs_map$[.@s])
			continue;
		if ($@sqs_type[.@s] == 2)
			dispbottom "[Chronicle] Side Quest hunting ground: " + $@sqs_now$[.@s], 0xE5A15E;
		else if ($@sqs_type[.@s] == 4)
			dispbottom "[Chronicle] Something here has been waiting for you...", 0xFF9977;
	}
	return;
}

// How far along RO's Broken Sword quest (b_sword) is, as one rising number:
// its values jump around (dead ends 11, 12, 13 and 15; 16 = sent to help Han
// Ran Jiao first; 25 = a wrong diagnosis, back to 24).
function	script	F_ChronKunlun	{
	.@b = b_sword;
	if (.@b == 11 || .@b == 12 || .@b == 13 || .@b == 15)
		return -1;
	if (.@b <= 10)
		return .@b;
	if (.@b == 14)
		return 11;
	if (.@b <= 23)
		return .@b - 4;	// 16 -> 12 ... 23 -> 19
	if (.@b <= 25)
		return 20;
	return .@b - 5;	// 26 -> 21 ... 33 -> 28
}

//@@NPCS@@
